title: call.completed
description: PAYLOAD of the `call.completed` envelope. Topic: engagement.call.completed. Emitted via the Origin Connector (§3.4) when the live Famit caller.py dial loop finishes a call (_classify_outcome). The raw call fact (answered/duration/disposition). The richer intent extraction is a separate call.outcome event (the moat feed). voice-adapter wraps the live LiveKit/Vobiz stack (§16.2). correlation by E.164 phone (§8.3).

call_ref.description: Source call id (Famit campaign_id:phone or call id). origin_ref in the connector map.

phone.description: E.164 — the correlation key (India identity king §8.3).

duration_seconds.description: Talk duration (a lead-scoring input §9.5; >=60s answered = a conversation-outcome audience seed §10.5).

campaign_ref.description: GROWTH OS / Famit campaign this call belongs to.

transcript_ref.description: Pointer to the transcript (consumed by call.outcome intent extraction + insight-miner §9.6). Recording consent per Indian telecom norms (§5.4).
